_comment: Phase 4.5 labeled retrieval set: 54 hand-crafted solutions engineering questions.
Written against the Phase 4 seed catalog (20 products, 18 capabilities, 25+ edges,
3 reference architectures). Each synthetic document is named <slug>-datasheet.pdf.
question           - the SE's natural language query
document_filename  - the ingested filename that contains the correct passage
text_contains      - a verbatim substring of the correct passage (survives re-chunking)
notes              - why this passage is the right evidence
capability-lookup      - does product X support capability Y?
multi-product          - compatibility, integration, or bundle questions
negative-unsupported   - questions the corpus should refuse or return empty
competitive-comparison - own vs resold or vendor vs vendor
reference-architecture - questions about named architecture blueprints

questions.question: Which of our products support SAML 2.0 identity federation?
questions.notes: Direct capability lookup. Apex Identity Broker's chunk explicitly mentions SAML 2.0.

questions.question: Does Aegis Zero Trust Gateway provide zero trust network access?
questions.notes: Capability confirmation against the ZTNA product. Exact phrase from chunk text.

questions.question: What deployment model does Nova Cloud Storage use?
questions.notes: Deployment model lookup from the synthetic chunk text.

questions.question: Which product provides distributed tracing and APM capabilities?
questions.notes: Strata Observability Platform has both distributed-tracing-apm and infrastructure-metric-monitoring.

questions.question: Do we have an event streaming product compatible with Kafka protocols?
questions.notes: Aether Messaging Bus description mentions Kafka compatibility.

questions.question: What is Vanguard SIEM's core function?
questions.notes: SIEM product description mentions its core function.

questions.question: Does Prism API Gateway support rate limiting?
questions.notes: Prism API Gateway description explicitly mentions rate limiting.

questions.question: What container runtime does Helios Container Engine provide?
questions.notes: Helios Container Engine is a Kubernetes-compliant container runtime.

questions.question: Does Krypton Key Vault support FIPS 140-2 compliance?
questions.notes: Krypton Key Vault handles cryptographic key management with envelope encryption.

questions.question: What mTLS capabilities does Nexus Service Mesh offer?
questions.notes: Nexus Service Mesh provides automatic mTLS for microservices.

questions.question: Can Okta Workforce Identity Cloud integrate with our identity platform?
questions.notes: Okta is a resold identity platform with MFA.

questions.question: What deep packet inspection features does Palo Alto PA-Series offer?
questions.notes: PA-Series NGFW provides deep packet inspection and WildFire.

questions.question: What are the prerequisites for deploying Aegis Zero Trust Gateway?
questions.notes: Aegis requires an IdP (Apex Identity Broker) for token validation.

questions.question: What infrastructure does Nexus Service Mesh require?
questions.text_contains: Requires Helios Container Engine or Kubernetes 1.28+
questions.notes: Nexus Service Mesh requires Helios or K8s 1.28+.

questions.question: What are the network requirements for Pure Storage FlashArray?
questions.notes: FlashArray requires FC or 25GbE SAN infrastructure.

questions.question: What does Helios Container Engine require on the host operating system?
questions.notes: Helios requires Linux with cgroups v2 enabled.

questions.question: What prerequisites does Krypton Key Vault have?
questions.notes: Krypton needs Apex Identity Broker for RBAC policy enforcement.

questions.question: What connectivity does AWS Direct Connect require?
questions.notes: AWS Direct Connect requires colocation or partner circuit to DX PoP.

questions.question: What do Cisco Catalyst 9000 switches need for power delivery?
questions.notes: Cisco 9000 switches require structured cabling and PoE+/UPOE.

questions.question: What does Aether Messaging Bus require for deployment?
questions.notes: Aether Messaging Bus runs as pods requiring Helios Container Engine.

questions.question: Can Aegis Zero Trust Gateway work alongside Palo Alto firewalls?
questions.notes: Aegis integrates with PA-Series for perimeter-bound untrusted traffic inspection.

questions.question: How does Apex Identity Broker integrate with Okta?
questions.notes: Apex has a certified SAML/SCIM connector for Okta integration.

questions.question: Which products are needed together for a service mesh deployment?
questions.notes: Nexus requires Helios; together they form the service mesh stack.

questions.question: Can Nova Cloud Storage be used as a staging area for Snowflake?
questions.notes: Snowflake prerequisites mention Nova Cloud Storage as an option for staging data.

questions.question: What monitoring options do we have for infrastructure metrics?
questions.notes: Both Strata (own) and Datadog (resold) offer metric monitoring. Strata is the primary hit.

questions.question: Which identity providers can federate with Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.notes: Entra ID handles workforce and customer identities across hybrid ecosystems.

questions.question: What products conflict with Aegis Zero Trust Gateway?
questions.notes: Aegis conflicts with Pure Storage FlashArray at L7/FC layer. Tests graph edge awareness.

questions.question: Can we bundle Fortinet FortiGate with our own firewall product?
questions.notes: Fortinet is a resold UTM in the same cybersecurity category as Aegis.

questions.question: What is the difference between our own SIEM and a third-party alternative?
questions.notes: Vanguard SIEM is our own product. Comparison requires multiple product hits.

questions.question: How does Strata Observability compare to Datadog for monitoring?
questions.notes: Strata (own) vs Datadog (resold) - both have infrastructure-metric-monitoring capability.

questions.question: Should we recommend our own identity broker or Okta for a new customer?
questions.notes: Apex (own) vs Okta (resold) - both map to identity-federation and single-sign-on.

questions.question: What are the margin differences between own and resold firewall products?
questions.notes: PA-Series (resold, 22-26% margin) vs Aegis (own, no margin band). Tests commercial awareness.

questions.question: Which campus switching solutions do we resell?
questions.notes: Cisco Catalyst 9000 is the only campus switching product in the catalog.

questions.question: Do we sell a product for quantum computing workloads?
questions.notes: No quantum computing product exists. Retrieval should return empty; generation should refuse.

questions.question: What is our product for autonomous vehicle fleet management?
questions.notes: No automotive/fleet product exists. Should refuse with no evidence.

questions.question: Which of our products support 5G network slicing?
questions.notes: No 5G product in catalog. Tests refusal on capability that sounds plausible.

questions.question: What is the end-of-life date for LegacyEdge VPN?
questions.notes: LegacyEdge does not exist in the catalog. Tests refusal on a fictitious product name.

questions.question: Can we offer a managed database-as-a-service product?
questions.notes: No managed DB product. Snowflake is a data warehouse, not a managed RDBMS.

questions.question: What is our product for physical access control systems?
questions.notes: No physical access control. Identity products are digital only.

questions.question: Do we have a blockchain or Web3 infrastructure product?
questions.notes: No blockchain product exists in the catalog.

questions.question: What is the SLA for our satellite communications product?
questions.notes: No satellite comms product. Tests refusal on non-existent product SLA.

questions.question: What products are in the Secure Hybrid Cloud Foundation architecture?
questions.notes: Secure Hybrid Cloud Foundation includes Apex, Aegis, AWS Direct Connect, Nova Cloud Storage.

questions.question: What does the Enterprise Zero-Trust SOC architecture include?
questions.notes: Zero-Trust SOC includes Vanguard SIEM, Palo Alto PA-Series, Strata, Krypton Key Vault.

questions.question: Which products make up the Microservices Production Edge blueprint?
questions.notes: Microservices Edge includes Prism API Gateway, Nexus Service Mesh, Helios, Strata.

questions.question: What is the recommended architecture for connecting on-premise to AWS?
questions.notes: Secure Hybrid Cloud Foundation uses AWS Direct Connect for hybrid transport.

questions.question: What support path does Zoom Phone have?
questions.notes: Zoom Phone has joint support: L1 PBX routing by SEs, carrier escalation to Zoom.

questions.question: Who handles L3 escalation for Microsoft Entra ID issues?
questions.notes: Joint support: L1/L2 by SE team, L3 escalated to Microsoft Premier Support.

questions.question: What is the partner margin band for Fortinet FortiGate?
questions.notes: Fortinet has 25-30% margin band, reseller-owned support.

questions.question: Which products use a consumption-based licensing model?
questions.notes: Nova Cloud Storage, Strata, Vanguard SIEM, Aether, Snowflake, AWS DC all use consumption.

questions.question: Which of our own products can be deployed on-premises?
questions.notes: Helios, Aegis, Nexus, and Krypton support hybrid/on-prem deployment.

questions.question: What OpenTelemetry support does Strata Observability provide?
questions.notes: Strata requires OpenTelemetry agent instrumentation.

questions.question: What threat detection capabilities does Fortinet FortiGate offer?
questions.notes: FortiGate UTM integrates firewall, SD-WAN, and antivirus inspection.

questions.question: What is the Datadog Agent requirement for monitoring?
questions.notes: Datadog requires agent installation across cluster nodes.

questions.question: Can Snowflake Data Cloud separate storage and compute resources?
questions.notes: Snowflake's architecture separates storage and compute.
